The Emerson results indicate a wider edge for Democrats than some other findings.

Decision Desk HQ’s polling averages put Democrats at an advantage of roughly 4 points, with around 46 percent support to the GOP’s 42 percent. results.content: Recent polling data, however, suggests challenges for the GOP. A national Economist/YouGov poll released on August 4 shows Democrats leading Republicans by 8 points on the generic ballot. Additionally, Trump's approval rating has fallen to 36%, with 60% disapproving of his performance as president.
